opening.quote:
Agent: Hello?
Agent: is this Tidewell? My toaster doesn't works.
opening.comment: The agent never gives their own name and greets the caller only with a bare 'Hello?', so the opening is missing a required element.

verification.quote: Agent: Yes. Thank you, Niamh, that matches your thank you account.
verification.comment: The agent accepted a name and partial address fragment but did not clearly confirm the full name plus order number or postcode before discussing the order, and the transcript is garbled.

understanding.quote: Agent: So toaster arrived yesterday and doesn't turn on that all?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the core issue that the toaster is faulty on arrival and does not power on, without re-asking what was already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: all refund the full €22.0 to card, you'll see a within 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Under the policy a faulty item on arrival may get a refund within 5 working days, but the item is under EUR 25 so no return is needed, and the agent did not state that; the €22 amount is otherwise consistent with the policy.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: all refund the full €22.0 to card, you'll see a within 5 working days.
process_compliance.comment: The agent did not ask for a photo of the faulty toaster before promising the refund, which is a required step for faulty items.

communication.quote: Agent: I'm sorry it doesn't work out of the box, that's disappointing.
communication.comment: The agent was apologetic and acknowledged the disappointment, though the later replies ('know.' and 'Right then.') were curt and unclear.

closing.comment: The call ends abruptly without confirming next steps or asking if there is anything else, so the closing is missing.
